research_status: fixed-rule universe restriction diagnostic; retrospective and not executable order validation

protocol.task: Fixed global rules restricted to US-listed securities; no candidate reselection
protocol.flow_policy: Slice original full-fund flow_pp and flow_kind unchanged; preserve original CU/common factors, actual cash, and NAV weights; do not renormalize inputs
protocol.ranking_policy: Recompute eligible rankings and price-feature percentiles on US security subset
protocol.benchmarks: Original direct TIME/KoAct ETFs and QQQ in KRW, 15bp initial buy, unchanged across stresses
protocol.fresh_holdout: Cash start at first August date; can enter that local close only; prior-day gain not earned
protocol.not_execution_validation: Universe restriction diagnostic on the original global calendar; not a replay of orders at 08:00-23:00 KST; assumes same-close fractional fills and daily FX marks
protocol.calendar_limitation: First global date of a week may be a US holiday. Closed holdings are frozen; weekly rules do not automatically retry next US session. The global 20-observation features also remain unchanged in time.
protocol.selection_policy: Never choose a new candidate from US-only realised returns; frozen IDs remain in declared order
protocol.cost_cash_assumptions: 15/30bp per side; zero interest on KRW cash; tax/dividends excluded; no leverage
protocol.listing_vs_nationality: US listing rule includes foreign-company US ADRs/listings such as SKHY and TSM; Korean/Japanese/Hong Kong/Chinese local-exchange listings are removed.
protocol.point_in_time_limitation: The source snapshots were retrieved retrospectively, mainly 2026-09-27. as_of_date is a disclosure label, not an archived publication timestamp. Execution must impose a disclosure delay; historical point-in-time availability is not proven.
